propositions: Affected Gerrit patchsets (1129/1130/1131/1136) omit fix commit 96a0d5c3f and retain unconditional --filter=blob:none followed by read-tree + checkout-index without up-front blob refill, causing per-blob lazy-fetch hangs lasting 1.7–4.3 hours until manual cancellation.

The reusable workflow _build-and-test.yml test job lacks timeout-minutes configuration, defaulting to GitHub's 360-minute limit instead of the documented 10–16 minute normal execution window, preventing automatic failure containment.

FakeJiraClient.search_issues in test_jira_dc_transport.py ignored startAt/maxResults pagination parameters, causing test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract to loop infinitely and timeout on Gerrit 1129 while passing on its parent.

Repository test matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) advance to 99% progress line then emit nothing for hours, indicating the hang occurs after test discovery but during test execution within the default suite.

Manual clearing of stuck runs by another session temporarily unblocks the queue but does not address the root causes, requiring fixes across blob-fetching strategy, workflow job timeout bounds, and pagination contract compliance.
